description: Hi! I'm a student from Khorugh, Tajikistan. I'm creative, curious, and always excited to learn something new. I'm interested in space, technology, science, design, and AI. I have experience in graphic design, Canva, content creation, teaching, and organizing activities. I'm looking for motivated teammates with skills in programming, science, research, astronomy, or design. You don't have to be an expert — just bring your curiosity, ideas, and willingness to learn!
